g.text: Fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence and Knowledge Representation
Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning for Business
Introduction to Languages for Artificial Intelligence
ai_introduction: History, applications, principles, and methods of AI.
ai_problem_solving_search: State representations, reasoning, and informed or uninformed search.
ai_agents: The notion and role of agents in AI systems.
cognitive_science: Classical and contemporary cognitive science related to AI.
python_programming: Python functions, data types, mutability, objects, exceptions, and NumPy.
functional_programming: Functional programming concepts and techniques.
procedural_declarative_programming: Practical systems using procedural and declarative languages.
abstract_machines: Models of program execution and language implementation.
logic_programming: Logic programming as an AI programming and reasoning approach.
prolog_logic_programming: Prolog solvers, programs, meta-predicates, and meta-interpreters.
knowledge_based_systems: Architecture and implementation of explicit-knowledge problem-solving systems.
knowledge_representation: Semantic networks, description logics, ontologies, actions, events, and rules.
logical_inference: Formal inference including Modus Ponens and Modus Tollens.
rule_based_systems: Prolog extensions, forward chaining, RETE, and Drools.
constraint_satisfaction: Constraint satisfaction as symbolic AI problem solving.
automated_reasoning: Automated reasoning and reasoning agents.
automated_planning: Linear, partial-order, graph-based planning, and scheduling.
games_constraint_planning: AI methods applied to games, CSPs, and planning.
optimization: Local search, metaheuristics, decomposition, relaxation, and branch-and-bound.
linear_programming: Simplex algorithm and linear-programming duality.
integer_linear_programming: Integer linear programming and hybrid extensions.
constraint_programming: Modeling, propagation, constraints, heuristics, restarts, and LNS.
boolean_satisfiability: SAT encodings, resolution, propagation, DPLL, and clause learning.
satisfiability_modulo_theories: DPLL(T), theory solvers, and combinations of theories.
probabilistic_reasoning: Bayesian representation, independence, and exact or approximate inference.
machine_learning: Symbolic and sub-symbolic learning, including trees, forests, neural, Bayesian, and inductive-logic methods.
supervised_learning: Prediction and recommendation from labeled data.
unsupervised_learning: Discovering patterns without labeled outcomes.
deep_learning: Deep learning as a machine-learning subfield.
statistical_inference: Regression, testing, intervals, sampling, variance, and reliability.
data_exploration: Operational exploration and analysis of business data.
data_mining: Classification, clustering, regression, and automatic learning for business data.
data_quality_bias: Dataset reliability, integrity, sampling bias, and signal-noise separation.
datafication: Converting behavior into data and risks of misinterpretation.
decision_support_systems: Evidence-based decision processes, structures, and implementation.
esg_performance_monitoring: ESG performance systems using machine-learning or data-science tools.
natural_language_processing: Natural language processing as an AI area.
language_models: Models for processing and generating language.
large_language_models: Large language models as AI technology.
generative_learning: Generative learning and AI creativity.
human_feedback_learning: RLHF and Direct Preference Optimization for agentic and generative systems.
autonomous_systems: Concepts and definitions of autonomy.
adaptive_autonomous_systems: Intelligent machines that learn through environmental interaction.
perception_actuation: Technologies for sensing and acting in environments.
robotics: Robotics and AI implications for recent robotics.
robot_navigation: Path planning using informed search such as A*.
behavior_based_robotics: Coordinating robot behaviors and tuning control software.
behavior_trees: Organizing and controlling robot behaviors.
evolutionary_robotics: Artificial evolution and automatic robot-program design.
fuzzy_logic: Fuzzy logic and systems in intelligent robotics.
reinforcement_learning: Reinforcement learning for robot adaptation and behavior acquisition.
robot_learning: Associative, value-based, and intrinsically motivated robot learning.
swarm_robotics: Multiple interacting robots and swarm-based behavior.
multi_agent_systems: Agent-oriented modeling and engineering of complex computational and socio-technical systems.
multi_agent_programming: JADE, Jason, and programming intentional agents.
multi_agent_simulation: Simulation for introductory multi-agent-system study.
agent_coordination: Coordination mechanisms, including nature-inspired approaches.
coordination_mechanisms: Cooperation and coordination in multi-agent systems.
algorithmic_game_theory: Cooperation, coordination, and social dilemmas in multi-agent learning.
multi_agent_reinforcement_learning: Reinforcement learning with multiple learning agents.
multi_armed_bandits: Bandit methods for sequential decision making.
swarm_intelligence: Ant-, bee-, and particle-swarm-inspired optimization.
ai_ethics: Ethical issues in AI and cognitive science.
ai_philosophical_aspects: Philosophical aspects and future AI challenges.
ai_alignment: Safety, value alignment, controllability, and self-awareness problems.
explainable_ai: Approaches to making AI systems understandable.
human_computer_interaction: Human-computer interaction issues related to AI.
human_machine_collaboration: Human agency, oversight, and action-feedback workflows.
systematic_literature_review: Systematic review methodology for intelligent and autonomous systems.
Existing course subsumed by proposed course
